Privacy Policy

Last updated: 12 August 2026

This policy explains what ALOP-AI collects, who it is shared with, and what you can do about it. It is written to be read, not to be skimmed past. If anything here is unclear, ask us.

1. Who we are

ALOP-AI is operated by Mohamed Fateh Douba, a sole trader established in the United Arab Emirates (“we”, “us”). We are the data controller for the personal data described in this policy.

Postal address: Style Tower 2603, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates
Privacy contact: privacy@alop-ai.com

2. Who may use ALOP-AI

You must be at least 13 years old to use ALOP-AI. If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, you must be at least 16.

We do not knowingly collect personal data from children below these ages. If we learn that we have, we will delete the account and its data. If you believe a child has created an account, email privacy@alop-ai.com and we will act promptly.

3. What we collect

You give us

  • Account details — email address, name, username and avatar, supplied through Clerk when you sign up or sign in with Google.
  • Conversation content — the messages you send, files you upload, images you submit, and the replies generated for you.
  • Screen captures — if you use the desktop overlay, the screenshots you choose to send.
  • Feedback — ratings and notes you submit about answers.

We generate or observe

  • Search queries — when a question needs current information, we generate a search query from your message and send it to the search providers in section 5.
  • Usage counts — messages sent, images generated, and your plan status, used to enforce free and Pro limits.
  • Billing references — your Stripe customer and subscription identifiers and subscription status. We never receive or store your card number.
  • Technical and security data — your IP address, browser user-agent, request timestamps, and an approximate region derived from your connection headers, time zone or browser language. IP addresses are recorded in our audit log and used for rate limiting and abuse investigation.
Search caching. To keep the service fast, the text of a generated search query and its results are cached for up to 15 minutes and may serve another user who asks a similar question. This cache is not linked to your account — it holds no user identifier — but it does contain text derived from messages. It is never readable by other users directly.

6. International transfers

The services above process data in a number of countries, including the United States. Where data leaves the UK or EEA, we rely on the receiving provider's own transfer safeguards — typically Standard Contractual Clauses or an adequacy decision. You can ask us for details of the safeguards that apply to a particular provider.

8. Your rights

Wherever you live, you can ask us to:

  • give you a copy of the personal data we hold about you;
  • correct data that is wrong;
  • delete your account and its data;
  • export your data in a portable form;
  • restrict or object to certain processing;
  • withdraw consent, where we relied on it.

You can delete individual chats and your account from within the app. For anything else, email privacy@alop-ai.com. We will respond within 30 days. We will not charge you or degrade your service for exercising these rights.

If you are in the UK or EEA and think we have handled your data badly, you may complain to your national data protection authority. We would rather you told us first.

9. California residents

This section applies if you live in California, under the CCPA as amended by the CPRA.

Categories of personal information we have collected in the past 12 months:

  • Identifiers — name, email address, account ID, IP address.
  • Commercial information — subscription status and plan history.
  • Internet activity — usage counts, request logs.
  • Geolocation — approximate region only, inferred from headers, time zone or language. Not precise location.
  • Other information you provide — the content of your messages, uploads and screen captures.

We collect these from you directly and from the services listed in section 5. We use them for the purposes in section 4, and we disclose them to the processors in section 5 for business purposes only.

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioural advertising. We have not done so in the past 12 months. We do not knowingly sell or share the personal information of anyone under 16. Because we do not sell or share, an opt-out is not required — but we will honour a Global Privacy Control signal as an opt-out request regardless.

We do not use or disclose sensitive personal information for purposes requiring a right to limit. You have the right to know, delete, correct, and to be free from discrimination for exercising any of these. You may use an authorised agent; we may ask them to prove they act for you. Requests go to privacy@alop-ai.com.

10. Security

All traffic is encrypted in transit with TLS. Database access is restricted by row-level security so one account cannot read another's data. API endpoints are rate limited, and administrative access requires several independent credentials.

No system is perfectly secure, and we will not pretend otherwise. If a breach affects your personal data and creates a real risk to you, we will tell you and the relevant authority without undue delay.

11. Automated decisions

ALOP-AI generates answers automatically. It does not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about you. Its output can be wrong, and you should not rely on it as professional, legal, medical or financial advice.

12. Changes

We may update this policy. If a change materially affects your rights, we will tell you in the app or by email before it takes effect. The date at the top always reflects the current version.
